description: Renovate's onboarding detected only .github/workflows/ci.yml here, because
it has NO Mill manager. build.mill was therefore invisible, and every JVM
dependency in it (7 of them) went untracked -- the dashboard looked
healthy while the actual dependency surface was unmanaged.
There is no Scala Steward in this repository either, so nothing else was
The customManagers below match the `Versions` object, not the mvn"..." call
sites: the literals live in Versions and the call sites only interpolate
${Versions.x}, so matching the usage would capture nothing.
Each coordinate was verified against Maven Central before being written
here -- the Scala suffix is not guessable. mvn"org::artifact:ver" resolves
to _3, mvn"org::artifact::ver" (double colon twice) to _sjs1_3 for
Scala.js, and mvn"org:artifact:ver" to no suffix at all.

packageRules.description: Keep the build.mill bumps in one PR rather than one per coordinate.

customManagers.description: Versions.scala in build.mill -> org.scala-lang:scala3-library_3. Scala 3 compiler/library line
Versions.scalaJS in build.mill -> org.scala-js:scalajs-library_2.13. Scala.js version (def scalaJSVersion)
Versions.upickle in build.mill -> com.lihaoyi:upickle_3. used BOTH as ::upickle: (JVM _3) and ::upickle:: (Scala.js _sjs1_3); the two are published together, so tracking the JVM artifact moves both
Versions.cask in build.mill -> com.lihaoyi:cask_3. JVM only
Versions.scalajsDom in build.mill -> org.scala-js:scalajs-dom_sjs1_3. Scala.js ONLY -- scalajs-dom_3 does not exist (404); the suffix must be _sjs1_3
Versions.munit in build.mill -> org.scalameta:munit_3. JVM test framework
Versions.scottyTag in build.mill -> oluies/scotty. a git TAG, not a Maven coordinate -- Scotty is checked out beside the repo, not resolved from a registry
